_about: SMALL TEST CONFIGURATION for checking the code end to end on a laptop or container (minutes, 2 cores). Same physics and analysis as final_model.json; smaller slab, thinner bath, 3 beats, shorter filter history, fewer placements. Not a scientific result.

tissue._about: Flat slab x in [-Lx/2, Lx/2] (propagation), y in [-Ly/2, Ly/2] (across the lesion boundary), z in [-wall/2, wall/2]; catheter on the +z (endocardial) side.
tissue._conductivities: Roberts and Scher 1982 (canine LV in situ), measured magnitudes and ratios, not scaled (DL-2026-11-02-03).
tissue._cellSurfVolRatioPerUm: beta = 0.14 / s with s = 6.42, the conductivity scale that gives 0.90 m/s at 0.5 mm (tune stage, DL-2026-11-02-03). A calibration parameter, not a measurement. 0.25 mm would need 0.0257.

lesion._about: Lesion = tissue with y < boundaryYmm, transmural, straight edge. The intact run keeps the same virtual boundary.
lesion._scar: All six lesion conductivities 1e-6 S/m (R10 decided 3 Nov 2026: insulating). Lesion cells keep the Courtemanche model but are not stimulated and are electrically isolated.

bath._about: 5 mm of blood on every side, no-flux outer walls, ground on a 1 mm cube at the (max x, max y, max z) bath corner, as Leenknegt et al. 2023 (assumption, not tested; DL-2026-11-02-02). Blood 135 ohm cm (Traugott et al. 1981).

pacing._about: Transmembrane current (openCARP stim type 0, uA/cm^2 of membrane) on the viable nodes with x <= xmin + stripWidth; planar wave along +x, parallel to the boundary. Single cell paced conditioningBeats times with bench before the tissue run.

numerics._forwardModel: openCARP bidomain = 2: monodomain Vm; phi_e from an elliptic solve with source sigma_m over tissue + bath. Every electrogram is openCARP's phi_e (DL-2026-11-02-01).
numerics._prepacing: Beats before the analysis run monodomain (no bath solve); state saved and restored with the bath on. Identical results (VL-2026-11-01-04). Restart time is computed from the window rule and filter history.
numerics._phieOutputHeightMm: phi_e is written only on the bath layer up to this height above the tissue (dataout_e = 3). Must exceed gap + 2 x electrode radius for every placement.

electrodes._about: 4 x 4 grid, 4 mm centre spacing, cylinders 1 mm long and 1 mm diameter with axes along x; gap = closest surface-to-tissue distance; 2 axial x 4 angular surface samples per electrode.

window._about: Measurement window from the intact last-beat activation of top-surface nodes under the grid: start = max(first - lead, stimulus end + minimum), end = last + trail, after the beat stimulus (DL-2026-10-28-08, confirmed 1 Nov 2026).

analysis._filter: scipy butter(order, band, 'bandpass') as second-order sections, causal sosfilt; unipolar signals are unfiltered.

calibration._about: Gain so that the median of the nine selected bipoles at the reference intact placement is targetBipolarMv. Imposed normalisation, not validation; source of 1.44 mV still open (R7).

changePoints._about: Clinical-style decay-to-plateau fit (reference/EFOV_analysis_pipeline.Rmd), one slab: profile least squares, exponential vs power law by AIC, zero slope after the change point.

groundTruth._about: Exact signed share of every tissue element in each recording (reciprocity lead field, same sigma_m source and ground as openCARP; DL-2026-11-01-02). No radius or cut-off.

acceptance._about: Checks applied to every run. 'physiology' and 'profile' values are project engineering criteria (DL-2026-10-28-05 and pilot), not validated biological limits. Implementation checks must hold to solver precision.

provenance._about: status: decided = recorded decision; awaitingWorkstation = rule-chosen in the final settings run on the workstation, value here is the expected outcome and must be replaced by productionModel.json (efov.config.importProductionModel).

tissue.sizeMm.source: recompute rule: 40 x 60 mm if domain_40x60_vs_60x90 passes, else 60 x 90 mm

tissue.spacingMm.source: decide rule: 0.5 mm if 0.5 vs 0.25 mm passes, else 0.25 mm (then beta 0.0257)

tissue.cellSurfVolRatioPerUm.source: 0.14 / s; s = 6.42 from the 1 Nov container tune (openCARP 19.0.0); workstation tune value to confirm. The CV check in every run guards it.

pacing.beatCount.source: recompute rule: 4 if beats_4_vs_8 passes, else 8

pacing.stimulusStrengthUAPerCm2.source: tune stage capture strength (starts at 50, doubled if no capture)

numerics.timeStepUs.source: recompute rule: 20 us if timestep_20_vs_10 passes, else 10 us

numerics.sampleStepMs.source: recompute rule: 0.2 ms if output_0.20_vs_0.10 passes, else 0.1 ms

tissue.wallMm.source: Li et al. 2024 posterior LA wall 1.48 mm (DL-2026-10-28-15)

analysis.calibration.targetBipolarMv.source: R7: source of 1.44 mV not yet stated
